name: Bakumatsu◆Kayo no Chigiri ~Tsukikage no Himegoto~
original_name: 幕末◆華夜の契り ～月影の秘めごと～
source:
A shadow falls over a dazzling world-an alternate Bakumatsu.
For generations, the Tokugawa shogunate was held up by a single sword, and those sworn to protect it.
You, flung from modern times into the past, are chosen as a candidate to guard the sword...
And to shield you from forces that can twist fate itself, you're entrusted to the Shinsengumi.
Thrown into chaos at history's end you meet men fighting desperately just to survive. Every day sweeps you along in their storm.
Your feelings give strength to the sword-becoming a pillar for peace in this world.
Will you embrace your destiny as Sword Keeper, or risk everything for someone you love?
Beyond secret vows and hidden bonds-what will your hands finally grasp?

[Translated from [url=https://ninoya.jp/contents/news/pr_13_hanachigi.php]the official website[/url]]
translation:
耀眼的世界蒙上阴影——这是一个与众不同的幕末时代。世世代代以来，德川幕府都由一把刀及誓死守护它的人支撑。你从现代被抛回过去，被选为这把刀的守护者候选人……为了保护你不受扭曲命运的势力侵害，你受托加入新选组。

历史走向终结，天下陷入混乱；你遇见一群为求生存而拼命战斗的男人。每天都被卷入他们掀起的风暴。你的情感为刀注入力量，成为这个世界和平的支柱。你会接受自己作为刀之守护者的命运，还是为了所爱之人赌上一切？

在秘密誓言和隐秘羁绊之外，你最终会握住什么？[译自[url=https://ninoya.jp/contents/news/pr_13_hanachigi.php]官方网站[/url]]
